correctness.rationale: Exhaustive five-composition enumeration for each forbidden weight 1–8 proves exact finite obstruction. Seven explicit H2-vectors and addition of a 5-term zero sum cover all allowed weights. LTE gives Hk as full preimage of H2; a last-summand lift transfers all t and reverse reduction forbids new t. Digit sum is equivalent to sums of distinct powers by modular exponent separation. Finite checker cross-validates bounded claims; infinite statements follow from proof.

value.rationale: A complete natural digit-sum spectrum at the first base-three Wieferich prime power is substantially stronger than the known shortest length. It reveals nonmonotone attainable weights 5,7 and holes 6,8 despite eventual full coverage at 9, and establishes stabilization at exactly the second prime-power level. This is a motivated exact representation invariant, not an arbitrary slice or cosmetic minimum improvement.
